answer: A harbor purchasing agent buying juniper should ignore a sudden pulse of glowing reviews. Rank suppliers using only deliveries that this buyer ordered and independently inspected, with no weight for outside endorsements or account counts. Unknown keys receive no reputation bonus; access to larger contracts requires a cumulative record of verified deliveries. A supplier cannot manufacture that record by trading among its own aliases, and abandoning a bad identity also discards earned trust. This limits reputation farming, though it slows entry and depends on reliable inspections.
